name: io.github.velella-sh/ebb
title: Ebb Lifecycle & Deprecation
description: Check package end-of-life, deprecations, replacements, and upcoming deadlines offline.

toolDescriptions.check: Call before installing or upgrading a package or runtime version. Checks against known end-of-life and deprecation dates. Example: {"purl":"pkg:npm/request@2.88.2"}.
toolDescriptions.check_all: Call before installing or auditing multiple packages or dependencies in batch. Checks each against known end-of-life and deprecation dates. Example: {"items":["pkg:npm/request@2.88.2","node@18.0.0"]}.
toolDescriptions.check_install: Call before running an install command. Parses package manager commands (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, pip, cargo, go) and checks every package against lifecycle rules. Example: {"command":"npm install request@2.88.2"}.
toolDescriptions.diff: Call to compare two lifecycle data versions, dates, files, or active data and inspect added, changed, or removed rules. Example: {"from":"2026.10.01","to":"active"}.
toolDescriptions.pick_version: Call before choosing a runtime or a major version. Returns known release lines, the recommended line, and whether coverage is complete. Example: {"purl":"node","as_of":"2026-11-15"}.
toolDescriptions.predict_eol: Call when an unannounced end-of-life date needs a planning estimate. Returns a predicted range, confidence and sources. Example: {"purl":"pkg:generic/golang","version":"1.26.0"}.
toolDescriptions.replacement_for: Call when a component is deprecated or end-of-life to find recommended migration targets or alternatives. Example: {"purl":"pkg:npm/request","version":"2.88.2"}.
toolDescriptions.sources_of: Call to inspect authoritative sources, archive snapshot URLs, health status, and review provenance for a lifecycle rule. Example: {"ruleId":"npm.package.request.deprecated"}.
toolDescriptions.upcoming: Call before planning upgrades to list scheduled deprecation and end-of-life deadlines within a time window. Example: {"within":"90d","ecosystem":"npm"}.
